title: 665. Maximum Average Subarray I

examples.explanation: The block [12,-5,-6,50] sums to 51, averaging 12.75, the best of the three windows.

hints: This is a portable adaptation: return the average as a finite, double-parseable decimal string.
Sum the first window, then slide it by adding the newcomer and dropping the leaver while tracking the best sum.
Divide the best sum by k only once, at the end.
